page.layout: One page of text, one column, no margin notes. Page number 433 at the head. Signature "Ec" and catchword "CA-" at the foot.

main_text.p: ctorem primum Schismatis, & alios Schismaticos, & Ecclesiae Græcæ proceres, Photium Patriarcham, Nicetam Byzantium, Eulogium Alexandrinum, Irenæum Martyrem, Theophylactum Bulgariæ, Armeniorum Catholicum, Demetrium Chomatenum, Petrum Antiochenum, & alios, quorum dicta laudaui Dissertatione mea ad D. de Boineburgh. Non puto tantorum virorum decreta perplacebunt, quod Ecclesiae Romanae votis subscribunt. Et, ut luculentius veritas pateat; inspice librum Græcorum Ecclesiasticum, cui Typico nomen est, in quo singulis diebus modus officij recitandi præscribitur, leges; Sæpius hoc modo Byzantij recitatur officium, Hierosolymis, & alibi aliter, nec unus semper servatur ordo in quatuor Patriarchijs: & nihilominus unum sunt, & diversa officiorum recitatio, discrepantes in dogmate sententias non efficiunt.

page.notes: The first letter of the page is cut off at the left edge of the scan; the opening fragment is kept as printed ("ctorem"). Long s has been read as plain s throughout. The small marks in the lower part of the page are stains, not text.
